nodes.description: Address stored as contract owner; set in Opulous constructor and used as the only authorized caller in delegate() and list().
Address of the Ferrum bot-protection contract invoked via low-level call in the checkBots modifier and in list().
Uniswap pair address computed at construction time by pairForUniswap and used as the bot-check pair argument.
Public mapping of token balances, mutated without SafeMath inside transferFrom and list().
Public nested mapping of allowances; written in approve/constructor and decremented without SafeMath in transferFrom().
Total token supply constant-initialized to 500000000e18 and used in list() to compute owner allocation.
IUniswapV2Router02 router instance at a hardcoded mainnet address used for addLiquidityETH in list().
Hardcoded WETH address used together with address(this) to derive the Uniswap pair.
Constructor: sets owner from tx.origin, derives uniPair, and grants unlimited allowances to the router and to tx.origin on the pair.
Public payable transfer entrypoint that delegates to transferFrom with msg.sender as the source.
Public payable transferFrom guarded by the checkBots modifier; adjusts allowance and balances with unchecked arithmetic.
Public payable approve that writes the allowance mapping for msg.sender.
Owner-restricted function performing an arbitrary delegatecall to a caller-supplied address and calldata.
Pure helper computing the deterministic Uniswap V2 pair address from two token addresses and the init code hash.
Owner-only listing function that sets balances, adds liquidity on Uniswap, performs a bot-protection call and distributes tokens in a loop.
Caller-controlled address used as transfer source, spender for allowance checks, allowance owner in approve and owner check in delegate.
Transaction origin used in the constructor to set owner and to seed an unlimited allowance on the Uniswap pair.
Block timestamp used to build the Uniswap addLiquidityETH deadline in list().
Arbitrary a.delegatecall(b) inside delegate(); executes attacker-influenced bytecode in the token storage context.
External payable call to uniRouter.addLiquidityETH inside list(), executed before the distribution balances are written.
Low-level call to protectionFromBots with selector 0x15274141 inside the checkBots modifier; unchecked external interaction.
Low-level call to protectionFromBots with selector 0xd5eaf4c3 inside list(); return value is ignored.
Unchecked arithmetic in transferFrom: allowance[..] -= _value, balanceOf[_from] -= _value and balanceOf[_to] += _value.
Unchecked arithmetic/assignment in list(): totalSupply * 6 / 100 and direct balanceOf writes from caller-supplied arrays.
Modifier performing an external bot-protection call and requiring the returned boolean before body execution.

edges.reason: transfer() forwards msg.sender as the transfer source to transferFrom.
msg.sender is used as the spender whose allowance is checked and reduced in transferFrom.
approve() writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] from the caller-controlled address.
delegate() gates execution on msg.sender == owner.
Constructor assigns owner = tx.origin, making ownership dependent on the transaction origin.
Constructor grants allowance[tx.origin][uniPair] = uint(-1) to the transaction origin.
list() derives the Uniswap deadline as block.timestamp + 600, creating timestamp dependency.
owner state variable is read in the delegate() authorization check.
Constructor writes the owner state variable.
Constructor invokes pairForUniswap to derive the pair address.
pairForUniswap return value is stored into uniPair during construction.
uniRouter state variable is the target of the addLiquidityETH external call.
transferFrom reads and writes the allowance mapping.
Unchecked balanceOf subtractions/additions in transferFrom can underflow or overflow.
Unchecked allowance subtraction in transferFrom can underflow.
totalSupply is multiplied and divided without SafeMath in list() to compute the owner allocation.
list() writes caller-supplied amounts directly into balanceOf without overflow-safe arithmetic.
list() body performs the unchecked arithmetic and balance assignment.
list() makes the external Uniswap addLiquidityETH call before completing its own balance distribution.
The external router call can re-enter transferFrom while list() state updates are incomplete.
checkBots modifier performs the low-level bot-protection call before the function body.
The untrusted protectionFromBots call in the modifier executes before transferFrom updates state, enabling reentrancy.
list() performs a second low-level call into protectionFromBots and ignores the result.
delegate() reaches an arbitrary delegatecall that executes attacker-supplied bytecode in the token context.
